atomic_adoption_barrier.accepted_limitations: Incomplete enumeration, unresolved rows and lexical-only consumer matches are follow-up work; a newly discovered actual consumer requires ownership planning.
atomic_adoption_barrier.negative_result_requirement: Record searched declaration identities, dynamic/reflection entry points, indirect imports and packaging; a zero exact-token count is insufficient.
atomic_adoption_barrier.new_consumer_action: Block adoption until ownership is planned.
required_chains: Gateway GraphQL/MCP -> HA queries, coordinator, subscriptions, semantic snapshot and fact tables
Gateway semantic snapshot -> Matter semantic feed
Gateway API -> Portal GraphQL, reflected objects and web assets
Native registry and driver declarations -> ebusgo, Modbus and tinyebus indirect/negative review
Dependency BOM -> add-on packaging, with packaging unchanged

limits: The existing discovery rows do not cover all public fields, returned map keys and dynamic/reflection declarations.
The external file lists and exact-token matches do not establish consumer completeness.
The complete custom metric renderer, boiler setters, owned GraphQL type/enum tokens and full context-qualified value map remain to be reconciled.
Merged library inventories and external source snapshots are not present in this worktree; no additional library meaning is asserted.
Consumer matches are lexical candidates, not verified semantic bindings.
Discovery identities identify source occurrences only; native_semantic_identity is not declared unless a bounded declaration supplies it.
coverage.scope: Existing bounded declarations and static discovery occurrences; partial coverage accepted for this naming wave.
coverage.target_representation: A rename target is an exact name. A removal target is an action object with no replacement name; it never creates a new public spelling.

purpose: Non-shipped partial consumer discovery for the bounded atomic adoption contract. Exact-token matches are candidates and do not establish complete bindings.
required_review: Inspect GraphQL reflection and dynamically constructed names.
Reconcile registered MCP names, dispatch, scope and emitted inventory.
Verify indirect and negative results for ebusgo, modbus, tinyebus and addon packaging.

adoption.supported_changes: Bounded naming maps, structural GraphQL syntax, registered MCP tokens, six circuit setters and explicit control withdrawals. Other vocabulary retains its recorded status.
remaining_questions: Selector-dependent target_temp_c retains its existing snake_case spelling.
Other unresolved native value and setter names remain provisional.
adoption.release_requirement: Renew affected security, hardware and candidate evidence; complete independent review, full repository gates and affected transport/conformance before release.
